blind.description: A woven brown wicker basket filled with various golden-brown crusty bread loaves and buns with flour-dusted crusts and score marks. A small white cloth or napkin is draped over one edge of the rim. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and well-textured with a stylized painted finish; no detached or floating elements.
blind.from_above: A round brown basket filled tightly with several golden-baked bread rolls and oval loaves, with a white cloth flap extending slightly past the rim on the left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-quarter the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 1.3 to 1.5 feet tall) and about 1.5 feet in diameter.
